description: This module actually can only make a copy of an existing authentication flow, add an execution to it and configure it.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Alias for the authentication flow.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_keycloak_url
parameters.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: authenticationExecutions
parameters.description: Configuration structure for the executions.

parameters.name: authenticationConfig
parameters.description: Describe the config of the authentication.

parameters.name: displayName
parameters.description: Name of the execution or subflow to create or update.

parameters.name: flowAlias
parameters.description: Alias of parent flow.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Priority order of the execution.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: providerID for the new flow when not copied from an existing flow.

parameters.name: requirement
parameters.description: Control status of the subflow or execution. Choices: "REQUIRED" "ALTERNATIVE" "DISABLED" "CONDITIONAL"

parameters.name: subFlowType
parameters.description: For new subflows, optionally specify the type. Is only used at creation. Choices: "basic-flow" ← (default) "form-flow"

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: copyFrom
parameters.description: flowAlias of the authentication flow to use for the copy.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the flow.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If true, allows to remove the authentication flow and recreate it. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The name of the realm in which is the authentication.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Control if the authentication flow must exists or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create an authentication flow from first broker login and add an execution to it.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    alias: "Copy of first broker login"
    copyFrom: "first broker login"
    authenticationExecutions:
      - providerId: "test-execution1"
        requirement: "REQUIRED"
        authenticationConfig:
          alias: "test.execution1.property"
          config:
          test1.property: "value"
      - providerId: "test-execution2"
        requirement: "REQUIRED"
        authenticationConfig:
          alias: "test.execution2.property"
          config:
          test2.property: "value"
    state: present

- name: Re-create the authentication flow
  community.general.keycloak_authentication:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    alias: "Copy of first broker login"
    copyFrom: "first broker login"
    authenticationExecutions:
      - providerId: "test-provisioning"
        requirement: "REQUIRED"
        authenticationConfig:
          alias: "test.provisioning.property"
          config:
          test.provisioning.property: "value"
    state: present
    force: true

- name: Create an authentication flow with subflow containing an execution.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    alias: "Copy of first broker login"
    copyFrom: "first broker login"
    authenticationExecutions:
      - providerId: "test-execution1"
        requirement: "REQUIRED"
      - displayName: "New Subflow"
        requirement: "REQUIRED"
      - providerId: "auth-cookie"
        requirement: "REQUIRED"
        flowAlias: "New Sublow"
    state: present

- name: Remove authentication.
  community.general.keycloak_authentication:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: admin
    auth_password: password
    realm: master
    alias: "Copy of first broker login"
    state: absent

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the authentication after module execution. return_values.description: Message as to what action was taken. Returned: always
